scope.method: GitHub commit search by exact identifier token, topn 100, ascending commit date

memory_recovered: Within the commit-search-visible set available to this run, no result preceding the existing unresolved-origin records explicitly assigns M-004, M-005, or M-006. Search-visible later references are status, collision-rejection, or temporal-boundary records and therefore cannot establish origin.

inferred: The searchable commit-message surface currently provides no positive provenance evidence for the identifiers.
The asymmetry in visible result counts is an indexing or message-content property and not evidence that M-005 has stronger or weaker historical validity.
proposed: Use exact-token commit search only as a candidate-discovery layer before branch and tree traversal.
Require file-content inspection and immutable object agreement before promoting any origin candidate.
superseded: Interpreting absence from provider commit search as exhaustive proof that an earlier assignment never existed.
unresolved: Whether an earlier assignment exists in file content, a non-default branch, renamed paths, unreachable history, or a privacy-reviewed non-repository source.
Whether provider search omitted commits whose messages do not contain the exact identifier token.

falsification_route: Enumerate all accessible branches and reachable commits rather than relying on provider commit search.
Inspect trees and historical file contents for exact identifier assignment before each temporal boundary.
Promote an origin only when explicit assignment, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and immutable locator all agree.
